findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` lemmas for `(quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor H I).obj A` and `(quotientPointsSubgroupFunctor H I).map χ`, pointing to `GrpCat.of (quotientPointsSubgroup H I A)` and `GrpCat.ofHom (mapQuotientPointsSubgroup H I χ)`.

findings.issue: `quotientPointsSubgroupNatIso` is public but has no `hom.app`/`inv.app` simp lemmas, so users cannot rewrite the advertised representation isomorphism at the functor level without unfolding `NatIso.ofComponents`.

summary: The direct quotient-points naturality and inclusion component lemmas are now present, but the new public functor/natural-isomorphism surface is still not fully characterized opaquely.
